evals.expected_output: Enters plan mode, suggests kv-shop-shop for confirmation, asks for the missing Azure tenant ID instead of guessing, and stops before ExitPlanMode without editing any file.
expectations: Enters plan mode (or states it calls EnterPlanMode) before any file edit or install command
Asks the developer for the Azure tenant ID rather than inventing a value

Detects npm from package-lock.json as the package manager
Stops before ExitPlanMode because the tenant ID is missing, and does not treat the plan as approved
